proof_body:
by
  intro p q hp hp2 hq h
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  haveI := Fact.mk hq
  have hpos : 1 ≤ 2 ^ p := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have e1 : (2 : ZMod q) ^ p = 1 := by
    have h0 : ((2 ^ p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 0 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).2 h
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos] at h0
    push_cast at h0
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 h0
  have e2 : (2 : ZMod q) ≠ 1 := by
    intro e
    have h1 : (1 : ZMod q) = 0 := by linear_combination e
    exact one_ne_zero h1
  have e3 : (2 : ZMod q) ≠ 0 := by
    intro e
    rw [e, zero_pow hp.ne_zero] at e1
    exact zero_ne_one e1
  have o : orderOf (2 : ZMod q) = p := orderOf_eq_prime e1 e2
  have d : p ∣ q - 1 := o ▸ ZMod.orderOf_dvd_card_sub_one e3
  have qodd : q ≠ 2 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact e3 rfl
  have d2 : 2 ∣ q - 1 := by
    have := hq.eq_two_or_odd
    omega
  have c : Nat.Coprime 2 p := (Nat.coprime_primes Nat.prime_two hp).2 (Ne.symm hp2)
  have d3 := c.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd d2 d
  exact ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hq.one_le).2 d3).symm
target_source: ∀ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ≠ 2 → Nat.Prime q → q ∣ 2 ^ p - 1 → q ≡ 1 [MOD 2 * p]
